items.tldr: Character.AI files for bankruptcy, sells assets to Disney for just $20M — once one of the hottest generative AI startups
items.tldr_zh: Character.AI 申请破产，部分资产以 2000 万美元卖给迪士尼——这家公司曾是生成式 AI 最火的初创之一
items.take: From 'most promising' to bankrupt in two years — did the product fail, or was 'AI companionship' never worth the valuation?
items.take_zh: 从「最有前途」到破产只用了两年——是产品失败了，还是「陪聊」这个需求从来就不值那个估值？

items.tldr: IMF warns a sharp AI stock correction could threaten global financial stability; chip stocks slide the same day
items.tldr_zh: IMF 警告：AI 股票一旦大幅回调，可能威胁全球金融稳定；同日芯片股集体下跌
items.take: When an industry's narrative is so big that 'if it crashes, it takes the world down' — is it still selling technology, or has it become a faith?
items.take_zh: 当一个行业的故事大到「崩了会拖累全球」，它卖的还是技术，还是已经变成了一种信仰？

items.tldr: Study finds reaction time fluctuates with breathing: exhaling sharpens visual response by 41 milliseconds
items.tldr_zh: 研究发现人的反应速度随呼吸周期波动：呼气时视觉反应快了 41 毫秒
items.take: You thought attention was about willpower, but your body votes before your brain — the simplest productivity tool might just be one breath.
items.take_zh: 你以为注意力是意志力的事，其实身体比大脑先投票——最简单的「提效工具」可能就是一口气。
